88961208.headline: Reavis Charges from Fourteenth to Win Bomber Stocks Opener at Oswego
88961208.description: Bomber Stocks Round 1 at Oswego Speedway. Twin Feature 2 winner: Jim Reavis #57. The #57 produces a 13-place climb in the second twin feature as Craig Schmidt leads the most laps.

88962942.headline: Roberts Controls Eldora Opener as Angell and Mcdonald Storm onto Podium
88962942.description: Cushion Kings Round 1 at Eldora Speedway. Feature winner: Josh Roberts3 #42. Josh Roberts3 leads 35 of 41 laps while two rivals climb eight positions apiece.

88985308.headline: Mixter Wins from Ninth in 60-Lap Mini Menaces Opener at Millbridge
88985308.description: Mini Menaces Round 1 at Millbridge Speedway. Feature winner: Mikey Mixter #69. An eight-position climb carries the #69 to victory in a 13-caution Feature.

88987054.headline: McClain Opens Yota Outlawz Season with South Boston Victory
88987054.description: Yota Outlawz Round 1 at South Boston Speedway. Feature winner: Kent McClain #75. The #75 leads 24 of 30 laps in a caution-free championship opener.

89009401.headline: McClain Completes Round 1 Double in Wide Open Revival at Lucas Oil
89009401.description: Wide Open Revival Round 1 at Lucas Oil Speedway. Feature winner: Kent McClain #75. A 36-lap lead and fastest lap put the #75 on top in the Dirt Pro Late Models.

89130026.headline: Puterbaugh Comes from Twelfth for Fairbury Bomber Stocks Victory
89130026.description: Bomber Stocks Round 2 at Fairbury Speedway. Twin Feature 2 winner: Chad Puterbaugh #20. The #20 takes Round 2 ahead of Vanderwood and Mixter after gaining 11 positions.

89131794.headline: McClain Leads 32 Laps to Claim Cushion Kings Round 2 at Limaland
89131794.description: Cushion Kings Round 2 at Limaland Motorsports Park. Feature winner: Kent McClain #75. A win from pole for the #75, with a ten-place charge by Mcdonald2.

89153778.headline: Mcdonald2 Wins from Ninth as Mini Menaces Visit Limaland
89153778.description: Mini Menaces Round 2 at Limaland Motorsports Park. Feature winner: Travis Mcdonald #88. Travis Mcdonald2 takes Round 2, despite Wayne Bridges leading more than half the race.

89155471.headline: Puterbaugh Takes Yota Outlawz Round 2 from Tenth at Lanier
89155471.description: Yota Outlawz Round 2 at Lanier National Speedway. Feature winner: Chad Puterbaugh #20. A nine-place recovery wins the Feature after Kent McClain leads 31 laps.

89178640.headline: Reavis Commands Port Royal Wide Open Revival with 44 Laps Led
89178640.description: Wide Open Revival Round 2 at Port Royal Speedway. Feature winner: Jim Reavis #57. The #57 wins Round 2 from second on the grid and sets the fastest Feature lap.

89302439.headline: Puterbaugh Makes It Back-to-Back Bomber Stocks Wins at Huset’s
89302439.description: Bomber Stocks Round 3 at Huset's Speedway. Twin Feature 2 winner: Chad Puterbaugh #20. A seven-to-first move and 21 laps led secure another Round 3 result for the #20.

89303933.headline: McClain Adds Charlotte Victory to Cushion Kings Campaign
89303933.description: Cushion Kings Round 3 at The Dirt Track at Charlotte. Feature winner: Kent McClain #75. The #75 leads 36 of 45 laps while Bryce Fries climbs seven places to second.

89327096.headline: Puterbaugh Leads 33 Laps to Take Mini Menaces Round 3 at Lanier
89327096.description: Mini Menaces Round 3 at Lanier National Speedway. Feature winner: Chad Puterbaugh #20. The #20 starts first, finishes first and sets the Feature’s quickest lap.

89328837.headline: Puterbaugh Wins Again as Yota Outlawz Tackles Concord
89328837.description: Yota Outlawz Round 3 at Concord Speedway. Feature winner: Chad Puterbaugh #20. The #20 leads 18 laps and moves from second to first in an 11-caution Feature.

89351486.headline: McClain Leads 40 of 45 to Conquer Wide Open Revival at Weedsport
89351486.description: Wide Open Revival Round 3 at Weedsport Speedway. Feature winner: Kent McClain #75. A pole-start victory and fastest Feature lap define Round 3 for the #75.

89471712.headline: Puterbaugh Extends Bomber Stocks Run with USA International Victory
89471712.description: Bomber Stocks Round 4 at USA International Speedway. Twin Feature 2 winner: Chad Puterbaugh #20. A ten-to-first charge delivers a third consecutive Feature win for the #20.

89473591.headline: Angell Takes Lanier Cushion Kings Win with 36 Laps Led
89473591.description: Cushion Kings Round 4 at Lanier National Speedway. Feature winner: Brian Angell #7. Angell leads 36 laps from pole, with Mixter second and Parrotta third.

89495168.headline: Angell Claims Chili Bowl Mini Menaces Feature in Round 4
89495168.description: Mini Menaces Round 4 at Chili Bowl. Feature winner: Brian Angell #7. A 35-lap lead and victory from second on the grid for the #7.

89496902.headline: Puterbaugh takes Yota Outlawz Round 4 at Limaland
89496902.description: Yota Outlawz Round 4 at Limaland Motorsports Park. Feature winner: Chad Puterbaugh #20. The #20 wins from pole as Mixter and Brewer climb onto the podium.

89519810.headline: Puterbaugh Climbs from Seventh to Win Volusia Wide Open Revival
89519810.description: Wide Open Revival Round 4 at Volusia Speedway Park. Feature winner: Chad Puterbaugh #20. The #20 comes from seventh to take Round 4 ahead of Angell and Mixter.

89643227.headline: Mcdonald Wins Limaland Bomber Stocks Round 5 as McClain Rises from Rear
89643227.description: Bomber Stocks Round 5 at Limaland Motorsports Park. Twin Feature 2 winner: Travis Mcdonald #88. Mcdonald takes the win as McClain gains eleven places to finish second.

89644712.headline: Mcdonald doubles up with Cushion Kings win at Volusia
89644712.description: Cushion Kings Round 5 at Volusia Speedway Park. Feature winner: Travis Mcdonald #88. The #88 adds a second Round 5 victory ahead of McClain and Puterbaugh.

89666377.headline: Mathew Land Leads 22 Laps to Win Langley Yota Outlawz Round 5
89666377.description: Yota Outlawz Round 5 at Langley Speedway. Feature winner: Mathew Land #091. Land leads 22 laps, with Schmidt coming from ninth to second.

89668025.headline: Tom Land Wins Millbridge Mini Menaces Round 5 from Pole
89668025.description: Mini Menaces Round 5 at Millbridge Speedway. Feature winner: Tom Land #91. Land takes the win and fastest lap as Fries climbs from tenth to fourth.

89690728.headline: Hurst Tops Lernerville Wide Open Revival Round 5 Feature
89690728.description: Wide Open Revival Round 5 at The Lernerville Speedway. Feature winner: Blake Hurst2 #15. Hurst takes the win ahead of Mcdonald, with Puterbaugh gaining eight places for third.

89810317.headline: Puterbaugh comes from eleventh to take Kern Raceway win
89810317.description: Bomber Stocks Round 6 at Kevin Harvick's Kern Raceway. Twin Feature 2 winner: Chad Puterbaugh #20. Ten places gained for the #20, with Jordan Mackie second and Brian Angell charging from thirteenth to third.

89812470.headline: McClain wins at Lucas Oil as Mcdonald and Angell charge onto the podium
89812470.description: Cushion Kings Round 6 at Lucas Oil Speedway. Feature winner: Kent McClain #75. The #75 takes Cushion Kings Round 6, with nine-place gains for both drivers behind him.

89834758.headline: Mikey Mixter takes Mini Menaces Round 6 at Kevin Harvick s Kern Raceway
89834758.description: Mini Menaces Round 6 at Kevin Harvick s Kern Raceway. Feature winner: Mikey Mixter #69. Chad Puterbaugh takes second, with Travis Mcdonald third.

89836161.headline: Kent Mcclain takes Yota Outlawz Round 6 at Kevin Harvick s Kern Raceway
89836161.description: Yota Outlawz Round 6 at Kevin Harvick s Kern Raceway. Feature winner: Kent McClain #75. Mikey Mixter takes second, with Chad Puterbaugh third.

89859608.headline: McClain takes the Knoxville win in Wide Open Revival Round 6
89859608.description: Wide Open Revival Round 6 at Knoxville Raceway. Feature winner: Kent McClain #75. Brian Angell follows the #75 home, with Mikey Mixter completing the podium.

89983608.headline: Kent Mcclain takes Cushion Kings Round 7 at Federated Auto Parts Raceway at I-55
89983608.description: Cushion Kings Round 7 at Federated Auto Parts Raceway at I-55. Feature winner: Kent McClain #75. Brent Vanderwood takes second, with Wayne Bridges third.

90005528.headline: Travis Mcdonald takes Mini Menaces Round 7 at Limaland Motorsports Park
90005528.description: Mini Menaces Round 7 at Limaland Motorsports Park. Feature winner: Travis Mcdonald #88. Chad Puterbaugh takes second, with Brian Angell third.

90006933.headline: Travis Mcdonald takes Yota Outlawz Round 7 at Oxford Plains Raceway
90006933.description: Yota Outlawz Round 7 at Oxford Plains Raceway. Feature winner: Travis Mcdonald #88. Brent Vanderwood takes second, with Craig Schmidt third.
